title: Track 1 live frame schema projection, and a splice refusal that leaves a record
claim: Both faults in the 10:00 ET failure are fixed and each has been observed failing when removed. The fix does not unblock today's Stress window: overlap_disagreement fires before the splice and is a price disagreement, not a schema one.

projection_owner.why: it is the ONLY caller of track1_live_frame.splice in the repo, asserted by a test that scans every production module in global_index/
projection_owner.guard_rationale: relaxing splice to 'extras are fine' would let a future caller that forgot to project hand it a wider frame and get a wider frame back, with provider fields riding downstream into every sleeve
projection_owner.order_rationale: schema before prices - the overlap check compares values column by column and cannot compare a column that is not there

rules.extra_provider_columns: DROPPED, names returned and carried on JoinedFrame.dropped_columns and in its record
rules.missing_frozen_column: REFUSED, missing_required_columns, naming the column; never synthesised
rules.nan_in_frozen_column: REFUSED, nan_in_required_columns, naming column and first bar
rules.column_order: taken from frozen, so the frames are identical rather than equal as sets

projection_owner.allowlist_rejected: an allowlist of average/barcount drifts the first time IBKR adds a field and would refuse a harmless new column; the general rule plus a VISIBLE drop is the safety property

splice_refusal.detail_shape: <guard code>: <guard detail>, e.g. 'column_mismatch: frozen columns [...] != live [...]'
splice_refusal.rationale: the stage is the reason and the check is the detail - the same shape gate_refused already uses for the intraday gate's codes
splice_refusal.acceptance_classification: observed_hard_refusal (decided=False and reason != gate_refused) - verified by test, not assumed

third_defect_found.evidence: the word 'telemetry' appeared once, in a comment naming the recommended directory; slot_timing/ was created and RAITS_TELEMETRY_DIR exported, and no Track 1 strategy slot had ever written a row
third_defect_found.consequence_before: the acceptance gate's no_timing_records was unsatisfiable and the p95 cadence check could never run on anything
third_defect_found.fix: begin() before argument parsing, mark() for sleeve/outcome, set_outcome('ok') on completion; off unless RAITS_TELEMETRY_DIR names a directory
third_defect_found.ok_semantics: 'ok' means the slot RAN, not that it decided - a named refusal is a successful observation and its runtime belongs in the cadence numbers

todays_evidence.why: it ran on the code as it stood, crashed in the splice and left only a window_open line. Back-filling it would manufacture evidence for a window nobody observed
todays_evidence.visible_proof: the Stress slots from 11:00 ET onward are the first with timing rows

correction_to_5q2.was_claimed: B-5R-A, the column mismatch, was the single thing standing between this route and a judgeable day
correction_to_5q2.is: it was one of TWO live-frame blockers. overlap_disagreement runs BEFORE the splice, so the Stress slots never reached the column mismatch and will not reach it after the fix either
correction_to_5q2.measured: every Stress slot today refuses with overlap_disagreement on MNQ

blockers_before_5r.what: one MNQ history bar disagrees with the live feed
blockers_before_5r.impact: refuses every Stress slot; MNQ is also in the swing basket
blockers_before_5r.kind: data question, not code - which of the two readings is right, and which to change

blockers_before_5r.what: NKD after 2026-11-01: 12 of 22 ET slots fall outside the Tokyo decision band

blockers_closed_by_this_stage: B-5R-B SpliceRefused crashed the slot instead of being recorded

older_tests_changed.was: asserted SpliceRefused / column_mismatch for a live half missing volume
older_tests_changed.now: asserts LiveSourceRefused / missing_required_columns, which names the column
older_tests_changed.note: the contract is unchanged; the refusal moved earlier and got more specific. A new test pins that extras no longer refuse, and the guard's own column_mismatch is still reachable and pinned in the 5Q-3 suite

older_tests_changed.was: fingerprinted scheduler_*.log before and after a shadow run
older_tests_changed.problem: the LIVE scheduler appends to it every five minutes, so the guard went red whenever the system was running
older_tests_changed.now: scheduler logs are out of the fingerprint; a new structural test requires the shadow entry point not to NAME a scheduler or log file
older_tests_changed.own_first_draft_was_wrong: '.log' not in src went red on the module DOCSTRING - a substring test over free text, the same shape as the freshness check 5Q-2 replaced. It now parses string literals and excludes docstrings

unchanged_on_purpose: global_index/track1_shadow_acceptance.py - the classification already handled live_frame_refused

operator.scheduler_restart_reason: each slot spawns a fresh run_live_day_track1 that imports the current modules from disk; the fix is already live and the 11:00 ET Stress slots ran on it
operator.backend_restart_reason: the dashboard reader is unchanged by this stage
operator.cli_verified: python monitor\ops.py restart --help - there is no --backend flag

followup_5q4.appended: 2026-08-24 (Stage 5Q-4). The record above is left as written.

evidence: it is the FILE'S LAST BAR
the feed's low is 4.5 pts LOWER - the only direction a partial minute's low can be wrong in
12 independent slot fetches over an hour reported it identically

new_blockers.what: update_ibkr_daily appends strictly-newer, so the bar the fetch stopped on is never revisited; every 13:45 leaves a partial boundary bar

the 13:45 pre-flight marks a day true before that day's SPY close exists; the regime CSV is permanently one business day behind the freshness requirement, and shadow_live binds that gate, so no candidate can be admitted at any instant
